sections.h: Our removal company at your side

body.p: Moving to Etterbeek soon? Looking for a reliable company to transport your belongings to your new home? Whether you are a private individual or a business, Gérard & Fils is here to help with the removal of your home, office, shop and more. Benefit from our company’s expertise in Etterbeek and leave all the handling and transport of your belongings to us. Active in the sector for over 30 years, our teams of removers are available all year round to move your goods. Our know-how and extensive experience make us the ideal partner for your move in Etterbeek. We offer many complementary services that take a great weight off your shoulders when you change address.

For many years, Gérard & Fils has supported residents and businesses in Etterbeek with their moves, with seriousness and professionalism. Whether you live near the town hall, in the European quarter or on rue des Tongres, our team knows the local specifics inside out: narrow streets, limited parking, buildings without a lift… We adapt our organisation to the realities on the ground to guarantee a smooth, stress-free service. Call on an experienced and responsive removal company for personal support, from the quote to the final set-up.

As a specialist company, we take care of every stage of your move in the Etterbeek area. Trust an experienced removal company. We guarantee tailor-made, stress-free support. Our service is not limited to hiring out a truck or providing skilled staff: we also give you genuine professional advice to organise every aspect of your move efficiently. Thanks to our expertise, you benefit from complete know-how, whatever type of goods need to be transported:

ul: Careful packing of your personal belongings, including fragile or valuable items
Protection of every piece of furniture before it is loaded onto the truck
Dismantling and reassembly of bulky furniture
Secure transport, with no risk of damage, to or from Etterbeek
Delivery and unloading in the exact rooms of your new home or business premises

body.p: With Gérard & Fils, plan your move in Etterbeek with complete peace of mind. Our professional equipment, including the furniture lift for access at height, allows efficient and safe handling. We also supply sturdy packing materials to protect your belongings from start to finish.

Are you renting a flat that no longer meets your expectations? Have you found the ideal place for your next rental in Etterbeek? Or are you about to become the owner of a house that matches your aspirations perfectly? Whatever your situation, our removal team is here to support you at every stage and guarantee a quick, worry-free and safe move-in. Contact us to tell us about your needs in terms of equipment, parking and services suited to your move.

For private individuals, we offer a wide range of services so that everyone can move with peace of mind, according to their budget. From the simplest package to the most comprehensive services, we ensure the safe transport of your furniture and belongings. Moving into the top floor of a building? Consider our furniture lift service in Etterbeek, ideal for moving heavy loads safely, without damaging your building’s lift or staircase. This equipment is also perfect for moving a piano or other bulky items to your new home.

Are you a business owner in Etterbeek or planning to set up your offices there? Call on our removal service dedicated to professionals. We understand the demands of your work and do everything we can to minimise disruption to your activities. Our experienced removers in Etterbeek take care of the whole operation: packing equipment, dismantling furniture, secure transport by truck, and installation in your new premises. If necessary, a furniture lift is used to ease access to upper floors and guarantee fast, risk-free handling.

Opt for our premium package to move your offices or shop as quickly as possible. For even greater convenience, we can also unpack the boxes and reassemble the furniture at the end of the move if you wish. You can also entrust us with cleaning the premises once emptied, to enjoy the benefits of a removal company that handles everything from A to Z.
What are the rates for a move in Etterbeek? Prices vary depending on the volume to be moved, the accessibility of the property and the distance. Contact us for a personalised, fast and free quote.
Do I need to apply for a parking permit for my move? Yes, the municipality of Etterbeek requires a prior application to reserve a parking space during a move. We can help you with this process.
Do you offer furniture storage near Etterbeek? Yes, we have several secure storage spaces in the Brussels region, easily accessible from Etterbeek.
Do you also move offices or shops? Absolutely. We handle business moves (offices, shops, professional practices) with tailored services planned to limit disruption to your activity.
